 This Crl.P Is Filed U/S 528 Bnss, 2023 Praying To
Quash The Impugned Order
DTD 30.11.2024 BEARING NO.DPN(1)CR/17/2022-23 ISSUED BY THE RESPONDENT VIDE ANNEXURE-D.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SACHIN SHANKAR MAGADUM  ORAL ORDER
The order impugned is a sanction granted by the competent authority under Section 19(1)(c) of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988.

2. The Learned HCGP has rightly brought to the notice of this court that the order impugned is amenable to writ jurisdiction and the petitioner could not have approached this court under Section 482 of Cr.P.C.
3.
The objection raised by the learned HCGP is upheld.
The petition is dismissed as not maintainable.
NC: 2025:KHC:37227 HC-KAR Liberty is however reserved to the petitioner to avail a remedy in the manner known to law.
